A second, unused white diaper lies in the foreground, slightly out of focus. The baby's face is partially visible, looking towards the right side of the frame.

The forearm and hand seem to disappear into the onesie sleeve with an unnatural tapering, making the wrist/hand junction ambiguous and slightly distorted.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The depth of field transition is somewhat abrupt and the blur pattern on the carpet lacks the optical consistency of a real lens, appearing more like a Gaussian smear.
